title: Protecting Our Planet
text:
Many people do not know that plastic bags can take hundreds of years to break down. In the sea, animals can eat them by mistake. This is a big problem for fish and birds. Some cities now ask shops to stop giving plastic bags.

Recycling is one easy way to help. When we put paper, glass and cans in special bins, these things can be made into new products. Trees are also important because they clean the air. Planting a tree is a simple way to help the planet.

What can be made into new products when it is recycled?
What can we infer about the cities that ask shops to stop giving plastic bags?
options: They want to protect animals and the environment
They want to sell more bags
They do not care about the sea
They want people to buy more plastic

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about helping the planet?
options: Small actions can make a difference
It is too hard for ordinary people

vocabulary.definition: a material made by people, used for bags and bottles
living creatures that are not plants or people
the large round world on which we live

paragraph_translations: Muchas personas no saben que las bolsas de plástico pueden tardar cientos de años en descomponerse. En el mar, los animales pueden comerlas por error. Esto es un gran problema para los peces y las aves. Algunas ciudades ahora piden a las tiendas que dejen de dar bolsas de plástico.

El reciclaje es una forma fácil de ayudar. Cuando ponemos papel, vidrio y latas en contenedores especiales, estos materiales pueden convertirse en productos nuevos. Los árboles también son importantes porque limpian el aire. Plantar un árbol es una manera sencilla de ayudar al planeta.
